purpose: Preserve one complete typed terminator per semantic block, including branch condition values, all branch/jump targets and return value IDs.

compact_block_candidate_scope.reason: Complete branch3 semantics require a condition value ID and three target edges; return semantics require a return value ID. A two-target structural record cannot be promoted as the final terminator representation.

logical_terminator.ordering_rule: terminator is the final semantic instruction of its owner block

verifier_requirements: every semantic block has exactly one terminator
RETURN has a valid type-compatible return value ID and no block targets
JUMP has exactly one valid target and no condition value
BRANCH3 has exactly one valid condition value ID and three valid targets
all target block IDs are inside the current semantic block domain
terminator kind agrees with the final semantic instruction opcode
no aggregate event opcode or structural two-target block record is accepted as complete terminator evidence
prohibited_shortcuts: treat ir_block_terminator > 0 plus target_a/target_b as complete branch3 semantics
recover branch condition by rereading raw source
drop the zero or positive branch edge
represent return without the returned semantic value ID
promote the compact block capacity candidate as W4 closure
